description: CTA - System Information - Bus Stop Locations in Digital Sign Project is a dataset listed in City of Chicago open data portal (data.cityofchicago.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Chicago. This dataset shows bus stops in shelters and at CTA rail stations which have digital signs added to them to show upcoming arrivals. The listing is subject to change. Coverage: Chicago. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are cta. The table has 18 columns. The portal shows 2016-03-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofchicago-org-portal.
